title: Colors and Patterns — God's Creative Order
memory_verse: "I have set my rainbow in the clouds." — Genesis 9:13 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn to identify colors and recognize simple patterns.
content: God created a world full of beautiful colors! Red roses, orange sunsets, yellow sunflowers, green grass, blue sky, and purple grapes!
God put all these colors in the rainbow! After the great flood, God gave Noah a rainbow as a promise. A rainbow has red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple.
God also loves patterns! A pattern is something that repeats. Look at a zebra — black, white, black, white. That's a pattern! A ladybug has a dot pattern.
Let's make our own patterns! Red, blue, red, blue. Circle, square, circle, square. God put order and patterns in everything He made!
activity: Use colored blocks or crayons to make patterns. Try: red-blue-red-blue, then circle-square-circle-square. Draw a rainbow and color it with all the right colors in order!
discussion: What colors are in a rainbow?
Can you name a pattern you see on an animal?
